counterReading.visibleWindow: one OWNED visible window per entered source
counterReading.runtimeStart: one OWNED Runtime per entered source
counterReading.cookieInjection: 26 authorized cookies per entered source, 3 sources: 78. No cookie value was ever logged
counterReading.focusEvent: one owned focus event per entered source
counterReading.mediaTask: one media task per entered source

historicalLowerBound.note: A LOWER BOUND over the retained logs of the EARLIER attempts of this stage. It is DISJOINT from the candidate totals and the stage totals of this batch.

authorization.note: The one-shot authorization of this candidate was consumed exactly once and it issued the six child grants. The per-source grant consumption is atomic and one-shot. The raw authorization value was never persisted and never appears in the evidence: only its digest does.
